crossRefs.note: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”

translations.web: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
translations.bsb: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
translations.kjv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
translations.asv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.
